title: Retrieval team members found living ETs peaceful

tellings.quote: and they've all been men so far, who have been operational on those retrieval teams that I've been meeting with back all the way to the early 90s, not a single one of them when they encountered a living one said they were anything but very peaceful, very enlightened, and and very kind,

plain: Men who served on secret teams that recover crashed craft and their occupants have, by Steven Greer's account, all said that the living beings they met were "very peaceful, very enlightened, and very kind." Greer, who argues that UFO secrets are held by a global cabal, tells Michels he has been meeting such men since the early 1990s, and links the account to a man named Jake Barber. He says not one of them described the beings any other way, which would mean the visitors are not a threat.
